name: openportfolio
description: Open, self-hosted, multi-tenant portfolio intelligence: one net worth across every account, the flows behind the price, and a Brier-scored track record of every call.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --filter @openportfolio/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @openportfolio/domain typecheck && pnpm --filter @openportfolio/node typecheck && tsc -p convex/tsconfig.json && tsc -p convex/tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --filter openportfolio-browser typecheck
scripts.site:demo: pnpm --filter openportfolio-browser build:demo && rm -rf site/demo && cp -R browser/dist-demo site/demo
scripts.site:build: pnpm site:css && pnpm site:docs && pnpm site:demo
scripts.site:deploy: pnpm site:build && wrangler pages deploy site --project-name=openportfolio --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.site:css: pnpm --filter openportfolio-browser exec vite build --config vite.site.config.ts

author: Seonglae Cho
